LanguageData.Lumen_Attunement_Desc: Wake dormant light implants and prosthetics. An attuner works on a colonist, prisoner or slave. The attuner's Medicine skill, participants and ritual support raise quality. A poor outcome wakes nothing, a successful one wakes 1 part, good wakes 2 and exceptional wakes 3 without attunement sickness. Each settlement recovers for {0} days.
LanguageData.Lumen_Binding_Desc: Wake dormant dark implants and prosthetics. An attuner works on a colonist, prisoner or slave. The attuner's Medicine skill, participants and ritual support raise quality. A poor outcome wakes nothing, a successful one wakes 1 part, good wakes 2 and exceptional wakes 3 without attunement sickness. Each settlement recovers for {0} days.
LanguageData.Lumen_Binding_SeedNote: A dormant dreadstone seed can be bound at any time. Waking only the seed starts no recovery and causes no sickness.
